task_objective: Treat a Ludusavi cancellation as ordinary cancelled control flow rather than a failed operation across the coordinator, lifecycle, RPC boundary, and QAM history text.
commits: fix(coordinator): treat Ludusavi cancellation as cancelled, not failed
fix(lifecycle): record a cancelled operation as skipped, not failed
fix(rpc): return cancelled operations as skipped without a traceback
feat(ui): label a cancelled operation as cancelled in the QAM

design_decisions.coordinator: LudusaviOperationCancelledError is re-raised after a debug log and updates in-memory operation status to last_result=cancelled and last_error=null; generic exceptions retain the existing error log and failed status.
design_decisions.lifecycle: Cancellation is converted to a skipped result, records history directly with the in-scope operation and trigger as restore/auto_start, and does not call dependencies.skip so it cannot misidentify the automatic restore as a manual restore.
design_decisions.rpc: Plugin._call catches only LudusaviOperationCancelledError before its generic Exception branch, logs at debug, and returns status=skipped and reason=cancelled without decky.logger.exception.
design_decisions.ui: The existing skipped text formatter renders cancelled as cancelled before it finished. The reason deliberately remains outside SILENT_SKIPPED_REASONS.

T4: should format a cancelled restore correctly

test_rewrite_rationale: The old guarded-restore test documented the defect: a cancellation re-raised and persisted a failed history entry. The implementation plan explicitly authorized rewriting that expected value. Its lock-release assertion was retained and strengthened by requiring a following manual backup to complete rather than report operation_running.

tdd_evidence.T1_red: The completed RED control failed because the old coordinator recorded refresh failed: Ludusavi operation was cancelled at error level. A first harness-only attempt used list.append as a four-argument log callback and was corrected before evaluating behavior.
tdd_evidence.T1_mutation: 6 coordinator tests passed with the implementation; stashing only coordinator.py made the new cancellation test fail on the old error log.
tdd_evidence.T2_red: The rewritten guarded-restore test failed with the uncaught LudusaviOperationCancelledError before the lifecycle conversion.
tdd_evidence.T2_mutation: 146 service tests passed with the implementation; stashing only lifecycle.py made the renamed cancellation test fail with the uncaught cancellation.
tdd_evidence.T3_red: The RPC test received status=failed rather than status=skipped before the new exception boundary.
tdd_evidence.T3_mutation: 36 main tests passed with the implementation; stashing only main.py made the new RPC cancellation test receive status=failed.
tdd_evidence.T4_red: The frontend test received Restore skipped — cancelled from the default branch before the explicit cancelled text case.
tdd_evidence.T4_mutation: 379 frontend tests passed with the implementation; stashing only operationText.ts made the frontend test receive the old default text.

fake_decky_module_debug_support: Yes. FakeLogger records debug calls in logger.debugs, so T3 asserts the exact debug message and that logger.exceptions remains empty.
source_plan_disagreements: pyproject.toml applies --cov-fail-under=83 globally. The plan's literal single-file T1-T3 commands and selected V2 command report every selected test as passed but exit nonzero solely because a partial selection cannot cover the whole package. The behavior and mutation checks therefore used the same commands with --no-cov; V1 retained the coverage-enforced full suite and passed at 90.13%.

The main checkout contained an unrelated, pre-existing untracked docs/plans/2026-08-26_update-check-suppression.md. It was preserved. Because V3 requires a clean worktree and its own git status check, V3 ran in a detached temporary worktree under /tmp/sdh_ludusavi instead of hiding, stashing, or changing the unrelated plan.

The temporary V3 worktree initially lacked node_modules, which created unrelated package-build and Vitest failures. That run was rejected as invalid evidence. Running ./run.sh pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts in the temporary worktree used the existing lockfile without downloads; the repeated V3 run named only the expected four new tests.
deferred_on_device_recipe: Install the dev build on a Deck and enable debug logging.
Launch a tracked game whose backup is newer than the local save, so the pre-game restore actually runs.
Press resume while the launch gate is still held.

In /home/deck/homebrew/logs/SDH-Ludusavi/, the newest log must contain no line matching start failed: Ludusavi operation was cancelled and no traceback for that operation, and must contain a Skipped start line whose reason is cancelled.
In the QAM, that game's history must show a skipped entry, not a failure, and the last-operation text must read Restore skipped — cancelled before it finished.
deferred_and_not_verified: No on-device verification was performed; watchdog gate-expiry behavior is exercised only by unit tests.

Unload cancellation is not covered end to end. T1 and T3 make its direct path quiet, but a refresh cancellation swallowed by registry.refresh_games can still surface as Ludusavi refresh failed in the frontend while it remains alive; that path is intentionally out of scope.
Timing was not measured. The change adds one exception clause per layer and is not expected to affect latency.
last_result=cancelled is a new in-memory operation-status value. Consumers of get_operation_status were not audited for unknown-value rendering, and the value does not survive a plugin restart.
results: All requested implementation, TDD mutation evidence, full quality gates, V2 boundary checks, and the valid V3 negative control completed. The unrelated untracked plan remains intentionally untouched in the main checkout.
